dedupe_keys.name: ifclca building life cycle impact calculator

description: IfcLCA is a web application for calculating construction life-cycle impacts from Industry Foundation Classes building models. It parses IFC material layers and quantities in the browser, maps materials to Swiss KBOB environmental factors, and exports charts or IFC elements with impact properties. Inputs are IFC4 or IFC2x3 files, element volumes, material assignments and project area; outputs include GWP, environmental impact points and non-renewable primary energy, either absolute or normalised by area and amortisation years. Coverage is the selected building project, with no fixed simulation period. Source is free under AGPL-3.0. The hosted application uses separate account services, while IFC geometry is parsed locally in the browser; derived metadata can be stored. A limitation is that only the eBKP-H classification currently supplies amortisation periods, and the README lists no built-in 3D viewer. IfcLCA can prepare embodied-impact assumptions for building design and material-supply models. It is related to other BIM analysis tools, but no IFC file was uploaded.
name: IfcLCA building life-cycle impact calculator
notes: G7 G7-1232. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability.
